kerberosServiceName.description:
The Kerberos principal name that Kafka runs as. This can be defined either in Kafka's JAAS config or
in Kafka's config. Will be used to set 'sasl.kerberos.service.name'

securityProtocol.description:
Protocol used to communicate with brokers. Will be used to set 'security.protocol'.
If Kerberos is used for authentication, it is done with SASL.

additionalConfigs.description:
additional configs that needs to used for client initialization, that are not listed specifically in this type. see
https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#configuration
